title: hogli is the task runner: test, lint, format, codegen entry points
answers: How do I run a single backend test in posthog?
How do I run frontend tests?
What is hogli and where are commands defined?
How do I run lint/format for python and JS?
body:
- `bin/hogli` is the central runner; commands declared in `hogli.yaml` (impl in `tools/hogli`, `tools/hogli-commands/hogli_commands`).
- Tests: `hogli test <path>` autodetects pytest/jest/playwright/rust/go. Single test: `hogli test path/to/test.py::Class::test_method`. Variants: `--watch`, `--changed`, `hogli test:python`, `hogli test:js`, `hogli test:e2e`, `hogli test:quarantine` (edits `.test_quarantine.json`).
- pytest config in `pytest.ini` (DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=posthog.settings, TEST=1, --reuse-db, asyncio_mode=auto).
- Frontend jest: `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend test` (runs `pnpm build:products` first; SHARD_INDEX/SHARD_COUNT sharding).
- Python lint/format: `hogli lint:python:fix`, `hogli format:python` (ruff via `bin/ruff.sh`, config `[tool.ruff]` in pyproject.toml). Type check: `uv run mypy --cache-fine-grained .` repo-wide (per CLAUDE.md), plus `uv run --no-sync ty check`.
- JS: oxlint (`.oxlintrc.json`) + oxfmt (`.oxfmtrc.json`); `hogli format:js`; types `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend typescript:check` (tsgo --noEmit).
- Read from configs only; commands were not executed.
